raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds a pre-commit check that fails when a Buildkite `source_file_dependencies` entry matches no tracked file, so a stale path can no longer silently stop a CI job from triggering. Related to #51225; complements #51345 (this PR edits no pipeline YAML and shares no files with it).

## Claims

- Catches the class of problem in #51225 permanently: any `source_file_dependencies` entry in the pipeline directories declared by `job_dirs` (`test_areas/`, `intel_jobs/`, `hardware_tests/`) that is not a prefix of a tracked file fails the hook, including entries nested in `mirror.amd` blocks. Exclusions (`!path`) are skipped: a dead one excludes nothing, so it cannot stop a job from triggering.
- Starts green without touching any pipeline: the 17 paths (36 entries) already dead on main are listed in `tools/pre_commit/source_file_dependencies_allowlist.txt`, which is meant to only shrink as they are fixed.
- The new unit test runs in CI: it is added to the existing CPU job that already runs the test-tethering check's tests.

## Validation

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `pytest tests/tools/test_check_source_file_dependencies.py` | 1 passed |
| `cd tests && pytest -v -s tools/test_check_test_tethering.py tools/test_check_source_file_dependencies.py` (the exact CI step command, real `tests/conftest.py`), in a CPU-only `python:3.12-slim` container with CPU `torch` and `requirements/common.txt`; no GPU | 139 passed |
| `python tools/pre_commit/check_source_file_dependencies.py` on this branch (rebased on `main` 4ac1f8d2ac) | exit 0 |
| `pre-commit run` on the changed files | all hooks passed (incl. the new hook and `check-test-tethering`) |
| Dead path injected into a plain step / a `mirror.amd` block | exit 1, names the file and path each time |
| Dead `!` exclusion injected | exit 0 (skipped) |
| Live path injected (control) | exit 0 |
| Allowlist emptied | 36 entries, 17 unique paths = the 17 allowlist lines |

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the injection check</summary>

Add `- vllm/injected_dead_dir/` to any step's `source_file_dependencies` in `.buildkite/test_areas/docker.yaml`, then:

```
python tools/pre_commit/check_source_file_dependencies.py
1 source_file_dependencies path(s) match no file:

  .buildkite/test_areas/docker.yaml: vllm/injected_dead_dir/
...
exit=1
```

The checked code never touches the GPU, and neither the check nor the test imports vllm. Full logs available on request.
</details>

## Details

- Motivation: #51225 was caused by renamed `csrc` paths leaving jobs that never trigger; the audit behind it found dead entries well beyond `csrc` (e.g. `vllm/worker/worker_base.py`, `vllm/sampling_metadata.py`). A hand fix doesn't stop it recurring.
- Design: reuses `job_dirs`/`JOB_GLOB` from `check_buildkite_step_keys.py` and `tracked_files` from `check_label_rules.py`; the allowlist follows `test_tethering_allowlist.txt`. About 80 lines of new code.
- Not a duplicate: no open PR or issue proposes this lint; #51345 and #61058 fix entries but don't prevent new ones; #61058 remaps most of the allowlisted paths, and this check complements it.
- Limitations: a path counts as live if it is a prefix of any tracked file (so `vllm/foo` is live if `vllm/foobar.py` exists); glob characters are not special-cased (none are used today); `.buildkite/test-amd.yaml` is not scanned (it is outside `job_dirs` and is being folded into `test_areas/`); a stale allowlist line is not reported, unlike the tethering check (six went stale between the first revision and the rebase and were pruned by hand).
- The check imports its sibling checks by bare name, as pre-commit runs it, so the test prepends `tools/pre_commit` to `sys.path`.
- AI assistance: this PR was prepared with Claude Code. I reviewed every changed line and ran the commands above.

---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Unit test for the dead ``source_file_dependencies`` pre-commit check."""
+
+import textwrap
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import yaml
+
+
+def test_dead_paths(monkeypatch):
+    # The check imports its sibling checks by bare name, as pre-commit runs it.
+    monkeypatch.syspath_prepend(
+        str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "tools" / "pre_commit")
+    )
+    from check_source_file_dependencies import dead_paths
+
+    pipeline = yaml.safe_load(
+        textwrap.dedent(
+            """
+            steps:
+            - label: job
+              source_file_dependencies:
+              - vllm/  # live: a prefix of a tracked file
+              - tests/b/test_x.py  # live: a tracked file
+              - vllm/gone.py  # dead
+              - tests/gone/  # dead
+              - "!vllm/excluded/"  # skipped: a dead exclusion excludes nothing
+              mirror:
+                amd:
+                  source_file_dependencies:
+                  - vllm/also_gone.py  # dead, in a nested block
+            """
+        )
+    )
+    assert dead_paths(pipeline, ["vllm/a.py", "tests/b/test_x.py"]) == [
+        "vllm/gone.py",
+        "tests/gone/",
+        "vllm/also_gone.py",
+    ]

@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Check that every `source_file_dependencies` path in Buildkite jobs exists.
+
+A job runs when a change touches one of its `source_file_dependencies`. A path
+that no longer matches a tracked file can never be touched, so after a rename or
+delete the job silently stops triggering on the code it was written to guard.
+This walks the directories the pipeline generator reads and fails on any entry
+that is not a prefix of a tracked file. Exclusions (a leading `!`) are skipped:
+a dead one excludes nothing, so it cannot stop a job from triggering.
+
+Paths already dead when the check was added are listed in
+`source_file_dependencies_allowlist.txt`, which is only meant to shrink.
+
+Usage:
+    python tools/pre_commit/check_source_file_dependencies.py
+"""
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import yaml
+from check_buildkite_step_keys import JOB_GLOB, job_dirs
+from check_label_rules import tracked_files
+
+ALLOWLIST_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "source_file_dependencies_allowlist.txt"
+)
+
+
+def dead_paths(node: object, tracked: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Every `source_file_dependencies` entry under `node` matching no tracked file."""
+    if isinstance(node, list):
+        return [p for item in node for p in dead_paths(item, tracked)]
+    if not isinstance(node, dict):
+        return []
+    dead: list[str] = []
+    for key, value in node.items():
+        if key == "source_file_dependencies":
+            for path in value:
+                if not path.startswith("!") and not any(
+                    f.startswith(path) for f in tracked
+                ):
+                    dead.append(path)
+        else:
+            dead += dead_paths(value, tracked)
+    return dead
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    tracked = tracked_files()
+    allowed = {
+        line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
+        for line in ALLOWLIST_PATH.read_text().splitlines()
+    }
+    files = sorted({p for d in job_dirs() for p in d.rglob(JOB_GLOB)})
+    if not files:
+        raise SystemExit("no pipeline files under the declared job_dirs")
+    found = []
+    for path in files:
+        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            found += [(path, p) for p in dead_paths(yaml.safe_load(f), tracked)]
+    found = [(path, p) for path, p in found if p not in allowed]
+    if not found:
+        return 0
+    print(
+        f"{len(found)} source_file_dependencies path(s) match no file:\n",
+        file=sys.stderr,
+    )
+    for path, p in found:
+        print(f"  {path}: {p}", file=sys.stderr)
+    print(
+        "\nA job never triggers on a path that does not exist. Fix the path in"
+        "\nthe job's `source_file_dependencies`, or delete it if the code is gone.",
+        file=sys.stderr,
+    )
+    return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+# Allowlist for tools/pre_commit/check_source_file_dependencies.py
+#
+# Every path below is a `source_file_dependencies` entry that matched no tracked
+# file when the check was added, so its job cannot trigger on it. These are
+# pre-existing gaps, listed so the gate could start green. The list is meant to
+# only ever shrink: fix the path in the pipeline yaml, then delete the line.
+requirements/rocm-test.txt
+tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_shutdown.py
+tests/entrypoints/openai/test_uds.py
+tests/plugins_tests/test_gguf_plugin.py
+tests/test_config/
+vllm/entrypoints/chat_utils.py
+vllm/entrypoints/logger.py
+vllm/executor/
+vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/pcp.py
+vllm/model_executor/layers/fla/ops/
+vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/cutlass_moe.py
+vllm/sampling_metadata.py
+vllm/transformers_utils/configs/qwen4_exp.py
+vllm/v1/distributed/
+vllm/v1/kv_connector/
+vllm/v1/spec_decode/qwen4_exp.py
+vllm/worker/worker_base.py
